clips.title: The story
paras: Tasked by Apothecary Johaan in Brill, this errand requires gathering scales from the local Vile Fin murlocs prowling the Tirisfal coast. The Royal Apothecary Society aims to harness unique biological reagents to refine their budding new contagion, ensuring it can spread beyond isolated victims to engulf larger populations.

Poisoning a single target is simple alchemy, but formulating a plague capable of sweeping across entire lands demands more complex components. Apothecary Johaan's ongoing research in Brill hinges on creating a disease that can self-propagate and endure in the wild. To engineer this transmissibility, he turns his attention toward the shoreline wildlife of Tirisfal Glades, identifying the resilient biology of the coastal Vile Fin murlocs as a promising source of raw material.

The northern and western shores of Tirisfal Glades are plagued by aggressive murloc tribes known as the Vile Fin. Harvesting their scales provides Johaan with organic compounds adapted to damp, harsh conditions. By incorporating the murlocs' slick, resilient scales into his developing cauldron, the apothecary seeks to bolster the virulence and environmental stability of the Royal Apothecary Society's new plague.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.
I will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity. You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The scales are perfect, friend. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.
